item.title: Herdr Notch 1.4.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • v1.4.0 could not launch. Embedding Sparkle made the binary link @rpath/Sparkle.framework/…, but the project set no LD_RUNPATH_SEARCH_PATHS, so the app shipped with no LC_RPATH at all and dyld aborted at startup ("Library not loaded … no LC_RPATH's found"). Signing, notarization and stapling all pass on such a binary, so the break was invisible until launch. The runpath is now pinned to @executable_path/../Frameworks.
